## Ingredients

- Yellow mustard  
- Brown sugar  
- Garlic, minced  
- Worcestershire sauce  
- Montreal steak seasoning

## Instructions

1. In a small bowl, combine mustard, brown sugar, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, and Montreal steak seasoning.  
2. Mix until smooth and well combined.  
3. Use immediately to marinate ribs for at least 2 hours (preferably overnight) before grilling or baking.

## Notes

- Adjust the ratio of mustard to sugar depending on desired sweetness or tanginess.  
- Store leftover marinade in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.  
- Works great on pork ribs, beef ribs, or even chicken.
